author: Rahul kp
title: Forfeiture &
simple_words: If a member does not pay a call, the company cancels his shares and keeps what he already paid.

definitions.meaning: Cancelling shares of a defaulting member for non-payment of calls, as per Articles. Amount already paid is not refunded.
definitions.note: Share Capital is debited with the amount CALLED up

definitions.meaning: Company sells the forfeited shares again, at par, at a discount or at a premium. Discount cannot exceed the forfeited amount of those shares.

key_points: On forfeiture, debit Share Capital with ==called-up amount==, credit Forfeited Shares A/c with amount received.
Unpaid calls (Calls-in-Arrears) are credited; premium not yet received is debited to Securities Premium.
!!Premium already received is NOT refunded!!, so debit Securities Premium only if premium was not received.
Reissue loss (discount) is debited to Forfeited Shares A/c; balance left there is the ==capital reserve== gain.

formulas.name: Capital Reserve on reissue
formulas.rhs: Forfeited A/c credit on these shares − discount allowed on reissue
formulas.legend: Forfeited A/c credit = amount received on those shares. Transfer only the gain on shares actually reissued.

entries.label: On forfeiture (premium received)
entries.narration: Being shares forfeited for non-payment of call

entries.label: On reissue at a discount
entries.narration: Being forfeited shares reissued at a discount

entries.label: Transfer of gain
entries.narration: Being gain on reissued shares transferred to reserve

insight.text: Forfeiture keeps the defaulter's money; the final gain after reissue is a capital profit, never a revenue profit.
insight.punchline: Profit here is capital, not revenue!

memory_trick.explanation: Money received stays in Forfeited A/c, reissue discount eats into it, and what is left moves to Capital Reserve.

exam_tip: MCQs ask where the net profit on forfeiture and reissue goes: Capital Reserve. Check the reissued share count first.

doubt.question: If only some forfeited shares are reissued, transfer all balance?
doubt.answer: No. Transfer only the gain relating to the reissued shares. Balance for unissued shares stays in Forfeited Shares A/c.

mistakes.wrong: Debiting Share Capital with only the amount paid
mistakes.right: Debit Share Capital with the full amount called up on forfeited shares.

mistakes.wrong: Crediting profit on reissue to Profit and Loss A/c
mistakes.right: Transfer the net gain to Capital Reserve.

mistakes.wrong: Transferring entire Forfeited balance when part is reissued
mistakes.right: Transfer only the gain on the shares reissued; keep the rest.
